title: Remembering Richard Heinberg: ‘Forever the empathetic observer and thinker’
content: A prolific writer, teacher and communicator trying to alert students, policymakers and the public to the limits to growth on a finite planet, Richard was, in my experience, also humble and a good listener, always interested in different perspectives.

title: Six ways advocates and organizations can practice solidarity for environmental justice

title: Remembering Richard Heinberg: ‘He was one of the clearest and steadiest voices addressing fossil-fuel dependence’
content: Richard’s writing never minimized the severity of the challenges before us, but neither did it surrender to hopelessness. Again and again, he insisted that another path could be imagined and designed—one based on ecological understanding, community-based economics, and a renewed culture of commoning.

title: As U.S. oil and refined product exports soar, will the Trump administration impose an export ban?
